quantity: Reconstructed tsunami height above ambient tide; conditional scenarios, not six measured watermarks or a probability distribution

scenarios.limitations: Assumed minimal foundation and storehouse siting above highest tides.
Low-ground inland storehouse assumed; inland decline transferred from 1960 analogue.
Oral-tradition site not securely identified as the building flooded in 1700; TP treated near mean sea level.
Assumed grain-damage depth and field elevation.
Printed 3 m versus component sum 2.6 m; compatible with whole-metre rounding, but rounding explanation not explicit.
Speculative near-rim flooding in moat; reaching Horidobashi does not measure crest height at rim.

shared_tide_assumption: Ambient tide 0.3 m below 1700 mean sea level, hence add +0.3 m. Timing inherited from documentary interpretation; tide prediction not rerun.

land_level_context.rate_basis_reported: Shirahama tide-gauge estimate 1967-1995, extrapolated to earlier intervals
land_level_context.coseismic_context: About 0.4 m measured in 1946, estimated for 1854; 1707 subsidence reported but amount unknown. Regional maximum map values must not be substituted for Tanabe values.
